# Remote state

Terraform state maps configuration resources to remote infrastructure. Remote state locking serializes concurrent writes so two operators cannot update the same state at once.

# Planning

The terraform plan command compares configuration with recorded state and provider observations. It previews proposed infrastructure changes without applying them.

# Write-ahead logging

SQLite write-ahead logging lets readers continue while a writer appends changes to the WAL file. A checkpoint later transfers committed pages back into the main database.

# Transactions

An atomic transaction commits every included mutation together or rolls all of them back. This prevents clients from observing partially updated records.

# Least privilege

A least-privilege process receives only the permissions and secrets required for its current operation. Removing ambient authority limits the impact of a compromise.

# Artifact verification

A SHA-256 checksum detects accidental or malicious changes to a downloaded artifact. A trusted digital signature authenticates the signed release metadata containing that checksum.
